status: Ten verified consecutive 100,000-agent sorts through actual Playground and Restart paths; same VM and native EKV store; no diagnostic maintenance flags or store resets
limitations: Timing varies under host I/O pressure; this is a local sustained check, not a cross-machine performance guarantee.
WAL byte fields in per-run records are logical file sizes, not allocated filesystem blocks or outstanding uncheckpointed data.
Native EKV consensus metadata and reusable database pages remain; the bounded key set assumes the same repeated input values.
Sampled peaks may miss instantaneous maxima; benchmark telemetry and resource collection add overhead.
